title: Topic autocomplete — free text + suggestions from available topics
description:
Replace the plain text Input for job node topic with a combo-box: free text entry that also shows a dropdown of known topics when clicked or typing.

Data source: GET /api/v1/config/system returns pool config with topic→pool mappings. Extract all known topics from this.

UI component: Create a Combobox/AutocompleteInput component:
- Text input that user can type freely (any topic string allowed)
- On focus or typing: dropdown appears with filtered suggestions from known topics
- Suggestions show topic name + mapped pool name (e.g. `job.default → default-pool`)
- Click suggestion to fill, or keep typing custom topic
- Fuzzy match on topic name

Wire into NodeConfigPanel for job node type, replacing the plain Input for topic field.

Backend: may need a lightweight `GET /api/v1/topics` endpoint that returns available topics from config, or reuse existing system config endpoint.
definitionOfDone: Job node topic field shows autocomplete suggestions
Free text still allowed (not restricted to suggestions)
Suggestions sourced from system config topics

implementationPlan.description:
Create `ComboboxInput` component in `dashboard/src/components/ui/ComboboxInput.tsx`.

Props: `{ value: string; onChange: (val: string) => void; suggestions: Array<{ value: string; label: string; description?: string }>; placeholder?: string }`.

Behavior: text Input that shows a dropdown list on focus/typing. Filters suggestions by fuzzy match on value/label. Arrow keys navigate, Enter selects, Escape closes. Click outside closes. Free text always allowed.

Dropdown: absolute positioned below input, z-50, max-h-48 overflow-y-auto, each item shows label + description in muted text.

SECURITY: All suggestion labels rendered as text nodes. Input value controlled via React state. No eval or dynamic property access.

Create `useTopics` hook in `dashboard/src/hooks/useSettings.ts` (or new file).

Fetches `GET /api/v1/config/system` and extracts topic list from the pool config's topic-to-pool mappings. Returns `Array<{ value: string; label: string; description: string }>` where description is the pool name.

Cache with `staleTime: 60_000` (topics change rarely).

Wire ComboboxInput into NodeConfigPanel for job node topic field.

Replace `<Input {...register('topic')} />` with `<ComboboxInput value={watch('topic')} onChange={(v) => setValue('topic', v)} suggestions={topics} />` where `topics` comes from `useTopics()` hook.

Verify `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`.
